text:
ana-docs: Drafting release notes for the SDK snippet sweep: we're standardizing chat/model call patterns and fixing several broken anchors after the site restructure. Posting draft snippets + migration checklist for quick review before I open the PR. :memo:

devon-sdk: nice. call out breaking rename: `client.createChat(...)` -> `client.chat.create(...)`. Also note header rename in REST examples `X-API-Key` -> `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Show both old/new so teams can search-and-replace.

ana-docs: small correction: my name is ana-docs, not nana :)

maria-docs: oops, fixed in my head. please include which SDK versions support the new patterns (js >=1.3.0, py >=1.0.0). Also add a short sed snippet to help large repos migrate.

ana-docs: updated (and yes seriously I'm ana). JS old/new examples:
```js
// old
await client.createChat({ model: 'kestrel-4', messages });

// new
await client.chat.create({ model: 'kestrel-4', messages });
```

```http
# old REST header
X-API-Key: <key>

# new REST header
Authorization: Bearer <key>
```

devon-sdk: Python example too and a tiny migration script: `git grep -l "client.createChat" | xargs sed -i 's/client.createChat/client.chat.create/g'`

hiro-eng: runtime note: both old and new calls are supported for a short deprecation window but the REST header change is enforced for new tenants; mention runtime min version v1.5.1 for header compatibility.

maria-docs: link housekeeping: several doc pages still point to `/guides/chat` anchor `#quick-start` which moved to `#chat-quickstart` after the restructure. Please add redirects for these anchors in the PR. Support ticket #8345 flagged customer confusion.

lisa-product: product asks: add a 'what changed' blurb and a short 'how this affects you' section for the changelog. Also request a 7-day deprecation banner for older SDKs.

ana-docs: adding migration checklist to the relnote: 1) upgrade SDK 2) update calls and headers 3) run integration smoke tests 4) verify telemetry for deprecated calls 5) roll canary at 3% traffic.

devon-sdk: include an automated test snippet for CI that fails if `client.createChat` still appears: `if git grep -q "client.createChat"; then echo 'ERROR: legacy API usage'; exit 1; fi`

maria-docs: also add a Known Issues entry: some customers using inline proxies may need to update proxy rules to forward `Authorization` header; mention Support template and ticket #8346.

hiro-eng: add perf note: no measurable latency change; just a surface API cleanup. Add a compatibility table referencing SDK/runtime versions.

deploy-bot: ana-docs pushed branch ana/sdk-snippet-sweep -> staging/docs (CI: passing) :white_check_mark:

ana-docs: thanks, PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7582 — contains snippets, sed migration helper, redirects, changelog blurb, and support templates. Planning to publish relnotes Thu 08:00 PT.

lisa-product: Marketing will prepare a short banner and we'll post in #product + #support after publish. Support will send proactive outreach to customers with custom proxies.

maria-docs: I'll proof the blurb early Wed and double-check redirects so linkcheck passes. small editorial request: avoid using 'breaking' in the headline; use 'API update and SDK migration' instead.

ana-docs: done. I'll merge after one more docs sign-off and then post publish timestamp here. Closing thread for now — will follow up with live URL.
